menu.name: Crispy Chole Poori
menu.description: Fluffy golden pooris served with spiced Amritsari chickpea curry, tangy pickled onions, and green chili.
menu.raw_materials: Whole Wheat Flour (150g), Chickpeas (100g), Cooking Oil (40ml), Spices & Herbs (20g)

menu.name: Khasta Moong Dal Kachori
menu.description: Crusty flaky kachori stuffed with roasted spiced yellow lentils, served with sweet sonth and mint chutney.
menu.raw_materials: Refined Flour (120g), Yellow Moong Dal (60g), Desi Ghee (25g), Asafoetida & Spices (15g)

menu.name: Royal Veg Dum Biryani
menu.description: Aromatic basmati rice slow-cooked with cottage cheese, fresh seasonal vegetables, saffron, and crisp fried onions.
menu.raw_materials: Basmati Rice (180g), Fresh Paneer (80g), Mixed Veggies (100g), Desi Ghee (30g), Saffron (1g)

menu.name: Dark Chocolate Truffle Cake
menu.description: Eggless rich chocolate sponge layered with smooth Belgian dark chocolate ganache and chocolate curls.
menu.raw_materials: Cocoa Powder & Flour (140g), Dark Chocolate (80g), Dairy Cream (60ml), Raw Sugar (40g)

menu.name: Amritsari Aloo Paratha
menu.description: Homestyle tawa paratha stuffed with mashed spiced potatoes, roasted cumin, fresh coriander, butter and curd.
menu.raw_materials: Whole Wheat Flour (140g), Potatoes (120g), Amul Butter (20g), Fresh Curd (80g), Spices (10g)

menu.name: Indori Masala Poha
menu.description: Steamed flattened rice tempered with mustard, turmeric, green chillies, crunchy roasted peanuts, and Ratlami sev.
menu.raw_materials: Flattened Rice / Poha (120g), Roasted Peanuts (30g), Mustard & Curry Leaves (10g), Sev (20g)

menu.name: Gujarati Nylon Dhokla
menu.description: Soft and spongy steamed gram flour cakes tempered with mustard seeds, sesame, and slit green chillies.
menu.raw_materials: Bengal Gram Besan (150g), Lemon Juice & Curd (40g), Mustard & Sesame (10g), Green Chillies (5g)

menu.name: Crispy Mix Veg Pakoda
menu.description: Golden fritters of onion, potatoes, spinach, and cauliflower coated in seasoned chickpea batter.
menu.raw_materials: Chickpea Besan (120g), Farm Potatoes & Onions (140g), Cooking Oil (50ml), Carom Seeds (5g)

menu.name: Thick Kesar Mango Shake
menu.description: Creamy luscious shake blended from real Alphonso mango pulp, full cream milk, and topped with dry fruit slivers.
menu.raw_materials: Alphonso Mango Pulp (150ml), Chilled Dairy Milk (200ml), Vanilla Scoop (40g), Pistachios (5g)

menu.name: Golden Honey Pancakes
menu.description: Stack of three fluffy eggless buttermilk pancakes served warm with natural organic honey and melted butter.
menu.raw_materials: Refined Flour (130g), Fresh Milk (110ml), Organic Wild Honey (35ml), Salted Butter (15g)

menu.name: Comforting Desi Ghee Khichdi
menu.description: Wholesome slow-cooked yellow lentils and fragrant rice tempered with cumin, garlic, and pure desi cow ghee.
menu.raw_materials: Rice (100g), Yellow Moong Dal (100g), Desi Cow Ghee (30g), Cumin & Hing (8g), Mixed Vegetables (60g)

menu.name: Classic Paneer Tikka Burger
menu.description: Tandoori spiced grilled paneer slab with roasted bell pepper, tangy mint mayo, and crisp lettuce in brioche bun.
menu.raw_materials: Cottage Cheese Paneer (100g), Brioche Bun (1 pc), Mint Mayo (25g), Lettuce & Onions (30g)

menu.name: Stone-baked Margherita Pizza
menu.description: Hand-stretched sourdough pizza with Italian plum tomato sauce, mozzarella bocconcini, and fresh basil.
menu.raw_materials: Sourdough Pizza Base (180g), Fresh Mozzarella (100g), San Marzano Tomato (60g), Basil Leaves (5g)

menu.name: Crispy Samosa with Chole
menu.description: Two crisp golden pyramid pastries stuffed with spiced potatoes and peas, drenched with spicy chole gravy.
menu.raw_materials: Maida Flour (120g), Potatoes & Green Peas (130g), Chickpeas Curry (100g), Spices (15g)

menu.name: Shahi Paneer Butter Masala
menu.description: Silky tomato, cashew, and butter gravy with fresh paneer cubes, served with two hot butter garlic naans.
menu.raw_materials: Fresh Paneer (140g), Cashew & Tomato Gravy (180g), Butter (25g), Tandoori Naan (2 pcs)

menu.name: Crispy Masala Dosa
menu.description: Golden paper-thin fermented rice crepe stuffed with fragrant mustard-potato masala, served with coconut chutney & sambar.
menu.raw_materials: Fermented Rice & Urad Batter (180g), Potato Masala (110g), Coconut Chutney (50g), Sambar (120ml)

menu.name: Chilli Garlic Hakka Noodles
menu.description: Wok-tossed hand-pulled noodles with colorful bell peppers, shredded cabbage, scallions, and toasted garlic oil.
menu.raw_materials: Wheat Noodles (150g), Bell Peppers & Cabbage (100g), Garlic Chili Oil (25ml), Soy Sauce (15ml)

menu.name: Warm Desi Ghee Gulab Jamun
menu.description: Two melt-in-mouth reduced milk khoya dumplings, deep-fried in desi ghee and steeped in cardamom rose syrup.
menu.raw_materials: Fresh Khoya / Mawa (100g), Refined Flour (20g), Sugar Syrup (80ml), Cardamom & Rose (5g)
